description: This file defines the SpecialOperatorValidator class, which implements validation logic for special operators within JSON API filters in SuiteCRM. It checks whether a given value is a string and then validates it as a special operator.

classes.name: SpecialOperatorValidator
classes.description: Validator class that checks if a value is a valid special operator string for JSON API filters.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the provided value is a string and a valid special operator. Throws InvalidArgumentException if validation fails.
